newsitem.title: GUATEMALA: Two dead in explosion in Guatemala City.
newsitem.headline: Two dead in explosion in Guatemala City.

text.p: Two women died when a package addressed to the owner of an employment agency exploded on Monday in an office building a block from President Alvaro Arzu's offices, police said.
"A device exploded after a person sent a package addressed to the owner of an office (in the building)," Angel Conte Cojulun, director of the National Police, told reporters outside the building.

The explosion at 10:55 a.m. (1655 GMT) blew out the windows on the fourth floor of the seven-floor Lubia building. Arzu, working in his offices just down the street, did not feel or hear the blast, one of his secretaries said.
Conte said the explosion happened in an employment agency that hired sailors for the merchant marine and cruise ships. Experts were working to identify the device, he said.

One of the dead women was identified as Maria Luisa Gonzalez, a secretary in the office where the explosion occured. The other woman has not been identified. A third person was taken to a hospital with injuries after the explosion.
